title: chore(i18n): delete the dead `configPanel.*` and `renderer.*` namespaces from the ten packs (#4746)
body:
Part of #4730

Fixes #4746

Deletes two dead i18n namespaces from all ten locale packs: `configPanel.*` (16 keys) and `renderer.*` (13 keys). 29 keys x 10 packs = 290 translated strings with no reader anywhere in the repo. No behaviour change is possible: a key with no reader cannot be read.

Verified at `f525dda22` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD` at the run that produced every number below).

## Re-measured first, at this tree

`node scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs --json`, run before any edit on a worktree cut from `origin/main` at `616a2a547`:

| | issue #4746 spot-check | this tree, before | this tree, after |
|---|---|---|---|
| total pack keys | — | 2839 | 2810 |
| referenced keys | — | 13811 | 13811 |
| candidates | — | 532 | 503 |
| CONFIRMED | — | 294 | 265 |
| NEEDS-REVIEW | — | 238 | 238 |
| `configPanel.*` | 16 CONFIRMED / 0 NR | 16 CONFIRMED / 0 NR | 0 / 0 |
| `renderer.*` | 13 CONFIRMED / 0 NR | 13 CONFIRMED / 0 NR | 0 / 0 |

Deltas are exact and account for the whole change: −29 pack keys (16 + 13), −29 candidates, −29 CONFIRMED, NEEDS-REVIEW untouched. Set-differencing the two reports confirms no key outside these two namespaces left either tier, and no key entered one. **No key in either namespace had gained a reader**, so nothing was excluded from the deletion.

## Evidence per namespace — the #4658 / PR #4731 standard, re-verified independently

**Zero call sites (AST pass).** Every key in both namespaces was a candidate, which by construction means no literal `t()`/`tt()` argument, no plural-suffixed spelling, no `returnObjects` branch and no dynamic template head reaches it. Cross-checked by hand — both return nothing:

```bash
grep -rnE "(t|tt)\(\s*[\`'\"](configPanel|renderer)\." packages apps examples e2e scripts docs \
  --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.js" --include="*.mjs" | grep -v /locales/
grep -rnE "\.(configPanel|renderer)\b" packages/*/src apps/*/src examples \
  --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" | grep -v /locales/
```

**Zero textual footprint outside the packs (safety net).** All 29 keys greped as fixed strings across the whole repo return **nothing at all** — a cleaner result than the previous carve-out, which had four fixture mentions:

```bash
grep -rFf keys.txt . --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=dist \
  --exclude-dir=build --exclude-dir=coverage --exclude-dir=.turbo -n | grep -v "^./packages/i18n/src/locales/"
```

**Plausible-consumer spot check, `configPanel.*`.** The vocabulary (`layout`, `columns`, `gap`, `rowHeight`, `refreshInterval`, `appearance`, `theme`, `general`/`advanced`, …) is dashboard-widget config-panel wording, and the two components that render exactly those labels import no translation hook at all:

```bash
grep -cE "useTranslation|useObjectTranslation|@object-ui/i18n|react-i18next" \
  packages/plugin-dashboard/src/WidgetConfigPanel.tsx packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardConfigPanel.tsx  # 0, 0
```

They hardcode the same words in English instead — `title: 'General'`, `title: 'Layout'`, `title: 'Appearance'` in `WidgetConfigPanel.tsx`; `label: 'Columns'`, `label: 'Gap'`, `label: 'Show description'`, `label: 'Theme'`, `breadcrumb: ['Dashboard', 'Configuration']` in `DashboardConfigPanel.tsx`. This is the same shape as the previous carve-out's `ProcessDesigner.tsx`, and it is not a package-wide absence of i18n: the two config panels that *do* use a translation hook read other namespaces — `packages/app-shell/src/views/ViewConfigPanel.tsx` reads `console.objectView.*` (`configureView`, `createView`, `discard`, `newView`, `save`) and `ReportConfigPanel.tsx` reads `common.cancel`/`common.close`/`common.save` plus `report.editor.panelTitle`. Nothing reads `configPanel.*`.

**Plausible-consumer spot check, `renderer.*`.** Dead in the stronger sense: the English strings have no hardcoded twin either. Each of `No page schema provided`, `No form schema provided`, `No dashboard schema provided`, `Page rendering`, `Dashboard rendering` and `Form rendering in` returns zero hits repo-wide outside the packs, as does the templated `for record {`; `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` imports no translation hook. The messages themselves are gone from the product, not merely un-translated.

**The i18n baselines.** Neither `scripts/i18n-en-drift-baseline.json` nor `scripts/i18n-call-site-key-baseline.json` names any key in either namespace (`grep -cE "configPanel|renderer"` → 0 in both), so no waiver ledger is left pointing at a deleted key.

## One correction to the issue's spot-check, and why the conclusion survives

Issue #4746 states that "**no component named `*ConfigPanel*` exists anywhere in `packages/*/src`**". That is not true at this tree — four do: `packages/app-shell/src/views/ViewConfigPanel.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportConfigPanel.tsx`, `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/WidgetConfigPanel.tsx` and `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardConfigPanel.tsx`. What the card was reaching for holds and is verified above in the sharper form: the two panels whose wording matches `configPanel.*` use no i18n at all, and the two that use i18n read different namespaces. The deletion premise (no reader) is unaffected — it rests on the call-site sweep and the textual sweep, both clean — but the card's supporting sentence should not be re-used as-is.

## No fixture rows to delete this round

The previous carve-out deleted rows from `ellipsis-glyph-3878.test.ts` and `untranslated-identity-4376.test.ts` because four `workflow.*` keys were pinned there. Checked again for these 29 keys: the repo-wide fixed-string sweep above returns zero hits, so no fixture pins any of them — `CONVERGED_KEYS` (the 33-key ellipsis census) contains none, and `LEGITIMATE_IDENTITIES` (the identity allowlist) contains none. Nothing to re-point, nothing to delete, no census note to write.

## Reverse verification — the guard that would catch an incomplete deletion

The fixture-guard reverse verification the card describes does not apply (no fixture changed). The failure mode this change *can* have is a pack missed, so that is what was ablated instead: with the deletion committed, `de.ts` alone was restored to `origin/main` (`git checkout origin/main -- packages/i18n/src/locales/de.ts`) — i.e. one of ten packs still carrying both namespaces. Predicted direction before running: red, from `all-locales-key-parity`'s "defines no key that en lacks" leg. Observed:

```
× de defines no key that en lacks 12ms
AssertionError: de has 29 key(s) absent from en: expected [ 'configPanel.advanced', …(28) ] to deeply equal []
Test Files  1 failed (1) | Tests  1 failed | 31 passed (32)
```

Restored with `git checkout claude/issue-4746-dead-namespaces-round-two -- packages/i18n/src/locales/de.ts`; `git diff --stat HEAD` is empty, so the tree is byte-identical to the commit, and the full i18n suite was re-run green from that restored state (45 files / 804 tests).

## Gates run — commands, so the re-test is a re-run

All at `f525dda22`, from the repo root of a worktree cut from `616a2a547`:

```bash
node scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs --json     # both namespaces absent; 2810 pack keys, 265 CONFIRMED
node scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs       # exit 0 — every in-scope call-site key resolves against en (2810 keys)
node scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs             # exit 0 — "0 en value(s) changed (0 added, 29 removed — those are all-locales-key-parity's)"
node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs        # exit 0 — 10 source files, 1 changeset
node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs           # exit 0
node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs        # exit 0
node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs             # exit 0 — 4263 tracked text files
pnpm --filter "@object-ui/i18n^..." build        # dep closure first, in a fresh worktree
pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/              # 45 files, 804 tests passed (all-locales-key-parity included)
pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check         # exit 0
pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n lint               # 0 errors (35 pre-existing warnings, none in a file this PR touches)
pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-dead-keys.test.ts \
  scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-en-drift.test.ts scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-call-site-keys.test.ts \
  packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage.i18n.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/chrome/ \
  packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.i18n-parity.test.ts \
  packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/__tests__/ \
  apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/AcceptInvitationRoute.test.tsx   # 18 files, 252 tests passed
```

The last one is the sweep of every consumer of the pack objects outside `packages/i18n` — the files importing `builtInLocales` (including `chrome/LoadingScreen.tsx`) that would see the deletion. `check-i18n-en-drift` abstaining rather than firing is the designed division of labour: deletions are `all-locales-key-parity`'s business, and it is green. The other seven repo gates (`check-action-forward-parity`, `check-doc-links`, `check-lint-coverage`, `check-phantom-dependencies`, `check-skills-paths`, `check-spec-symbol-derivation`, `check-type-check-coverage`) were also run and exit 0, though none is implicated by a locale-pack deletion.

Every pack drops 33 lines; 330 deletions total, plus the changeset.

## Out of scope, deliberately untouched

`console.objectView.*` (decision pending on #4730), the partially-live namespaces (`search`, `table`, `report`, `form`, `appDesigner` — key-level trims, not whole-namespace), and red-ifying the dead-keys script (`--strict` stays unwired).
